verdict.rationale: Skyfire is an identity/payments infrastructure platform for agents, not itself an agent or assistant that consumes external tools — it exposes its OWN MCP server for other agents to call (skyfire-docs-6, skyfire-docs-31), which is the opposite (server) role. The story of plugging external MCP servers into Skyfire so it can use their tools is a category error for this kind of product.
